title: Yoast snippet variable adds a space before the following comma
symptoms: SEO title reads 'Product Name , a Brand' with a stray space
cause: In Yoast's template editor a %%variable%% chip renders with a trailing space.
fix: Do not put punctuation directly after a variable; restructure the sentence.
apply: Write '%%term_title%% from Brand' rather than '%%term_title%%, Brand'
affected: Yoast SEO Search Appearance templates, September 2026
